free_tier.stated: no free tier. Three paid seat plans with a monthly Credit quota per seat: Standard seat USD 20 a seat a month (list USD 30) for 25,000 Credits, Pro seat USD 75 (list USD 100) for 100,000 and Max seat USD 200 for 250,000. A shared Credit Pack adds 625,000 Credits for USD 700 a month
free_tier.notes: the unit is the vendor's Credit; the Credits that one request costs depend on model type, token usage, thinking mode and tool calls. The lower seat prices apply to monthly subscriptions only and are marked limited-time

interface_detail: OpenAI-compatible base URL https://token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com/compatible-mode/v1 and Anthropic-compatible base URL https://token-plan.maas.qwencloudapi.com/apps/anthropic, with one sk-sp- key for each assigned seat. Models include the Personal Edition set and also kimi-k2.7-code, glm-5 and MiniMax-M2.5. An admin console assigns seats, shows usage by member and offers SAML single sign-on
tooling: any tool that accepts a custom base URL and key and speaks the OpenAI or Anthropic protocol; the owner assigns a seat to each member in the Token Plan management console and the member's key is set in the tool
chaining: a seat key replaces the pay-as-you-go key inside a coding client; the shared Credit Pack takes overage after a seat quota ends, and a key recorded under inference continues the work when every quota is used up

limits.value: Standard seat 25,000 Credits a month, Pro seat 100,000, Max seat 250,000; Credits go to the seat quota first, then to the shared Credit Pack; the service is suspended when all quotas are used up, until the next billing cycle or a Credit Pack purchase
a Credit Pack gives 625,000 Credits for USD 700, is shared by all seats and is valid for one month
up to 1,000 seats in one Team Edition subscription

limits_note: the quota unit is the vendor's Credit and not a byte, so volume-quota is the nearest term; the plan is sold and used only in the Singapore region with global deployment, and one account holds one Token Plan subscription of this edition
binding_note: the monthly Credit quota of the seat ends use first, and the shared Credit Pack is the only way to add capacity inside the month

identity_cost.detail: A QwenCloud account is made with a GitHub login or an email address with an emailed verification code, and it is an Alibaba Cloud international main account. QwenCloud takes payment with a card, PayPal, Google Pay or Apple Pay plus billing details: a name, an address and a mobile number that receives a verification code. Linking a card places a USD 1.00 pre-authorization. The owner adds each member by account name, and a member added by hand can use a key but cannot sign in to the management console. What the Team Edition checkout asks beyond these fields: unverified: behind a sign-up

reliability_note: a subscription with no Credits left suspends service until the next billing cycle or a Credit Pack purchase; a key used for scripts or application backends can be suspended; the limited-time seat prices can change
confidence_note: seat prices, quotas, base URLs and account rules are quoted from the vendor documentation read on 2026-11-02. The quotas are the vendor's published numbers and are not a measurement. Team Edition checkout fields are unverified: behind a sign-up
